tool.name: Biomni: Quick Deformable Registration
tool.description: Quick deformable registration function for Biomni integration.
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/quick_deformable_registration_wrapper.py' --output '$output' --fixed_image_path '$fixed_image_path' --moving_image_path '$moving_image_path' --output_dir '$output_dir' #if $metric --metric '$metric' #end if #if $optimizer --optimizer '$optimizer' #end if #if $preprocess --preprocess #end if #if $create_visualizations --create_visualizations #end if #if $learning_rate --learning_rate '$learning_rate' #end if #if $number_of_iterations --number_of_iterations '$number_of_iterations' #end if #if $gradient_convergence_tolerance --gradient_convergence_tolerance '$gradient_convergence_tolerance' #end if #if $number_of_control_points --number_of_control_points '$number_of_control_points' #end if
tool.help:
**Biomni: Quick Deformable Registration**
Quick deformable registration function for Biomni integration.
Args: fixed_image_path: Path to reference image moving_image_path: Path to image to register output_dir: Directory to save results metric: Similarity metric optimizer: Optimization method preprocess: Whether to preprocess images create_visualizations: Whether to create visualizations learning_rate: Learning rate for optimizer number_of_iterations: Maximum iterations gradient_convergence_tolerance: Convergence tolerance number_of_control_points: Number of B-spline control points
Returns: Dictionary with registration results
**Domain**: bioimaging **Function**: quick_deformable_registration
